subject: Arkwell exec demo — VP attendance and break-glass on-call sponsor
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@arkwell.com>, Ben Thornton <ben.thornton@arkwell.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arkwell exec demo — VP availability and break-glass on-call sponsor

Hi Samira / Ben,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood — excited to show Arkwell what we can do for your ingestion and inference latency goals. At this stage the most valuable audience for the first demo is the VP of Engineering and the CIO (high-level architecture + cost/latency SLAs). Can you confirm whether either will be able to join the session?

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 11/2 10:00–11:00
- Wed 11/3 14:00–15:00
- Thu 11/4 09:30–10:30

If the VP/CIO can't make it live, we typically run the session with a product lead and offer a break-glass on-call sponsor — a short standby rotation where an exec can jump in for the last 15 minutes if needed. That helps keep momentum while respecting busy calendars.

Attached: Arkwell_demo_agenda_v1.pdf and a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP_Arkwell_v1.xlsx). If you can share any timing constraints for your execs I’ll lock the invite and set up a 15-min dry run for internal presenters.

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred demo window above
2) Flag whether VP/CIO will join or if we should enable break-glass sponsor coverage
3) If break-glass, confirm best phone for rapid reach (or we can use Slack/Teams)

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 415-555-0123
redwood.ai

Attachments: Arkwell_demo_agenda_v1.pdf (3 pages), MAP_Arkwell_v1.xlsx (1 sheet)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@arkwell.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Thornton <ben.thornton@arkwell.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arkwell exec demo — VP availability and break-glass on-call sponsor

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear options. Quick update from our side: our CTO is traveling the first week of Nov and won’t be available. The VP of Engineering can potentially join, but only in the morning on 11/2. Ben and I would prefer 11/3 if we can get that to work.

If the VP can’t make 11/3, the break-glass on-call sponsor sounds reasonable. One ask: can you document the escalation flow and whether the on-call sponsor would be expected to field technical Q&A or just participate for strategic alignment? We need to be explicit for our execs.

Also I didn’t see a security one-pager — do you have a short SOC2 / enterprise compliance brief we can circulate to our security team before the session?

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships, Arkwell Systems
samira.khan@arkwell.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@arkwell.com>, Ben Thornton <ben.thornton@arkwell.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arkwell exec demo — VP availability and break-glass on-call sponsor

Samira — thanks for the quick reply. Two quick clarifications and a proposed runbook so your security and leadership teams can sign off easily: 

1) Break-glass on-call sponsor scope:
- Primary: strategic alignment and approval-level questions (pricing, SLA, roadmap).
- Secondary (optional): high-level technical clarifications only — we will not expect the sponsor to deep-dive into kernel-level tuning or infra configs. Technical deep-dive stays with our product/solutions engineer.
- Escalation: sponsor will be paged (SMS + email) and will join via the calendar meeting link within 10 minutes if available.

2) Security brief: attaching a short SOC2 summary and will share the SOC2 binder via secure link once NDA adds are complete.

Proposed schedule (PT) given CTO travel constraints:
- Primary slot: Wed 11/3 14:00–15:00 — we’ll aim for VP to join this slot.
- Fallback: Tue 11/2 10:00–10:45 with break-glass sponsor enabled (last 15 minutes reserved for exec join).

Internal dry-run: Tue 11/2 09:15–09:35 PT (15 min) — internal only, to rehearse the handoff and the last-15-min exec bridge.

I’ve attached an updated agenda (Arkwell_demo_agenda_v2.pdf) that marks the exec touchpoints and the handoff language for the sponsor. If this looks good I’ll:
- Send calendar invites for the primary slot and dry-run
- Add Priyom as the internal lead to manage the break-glass page/notify flow

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Arkwell_demo_agenda_v2.pdf (3 pages), SOC2_onepager.pdf (1 page)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@arkwell.com>, Ben Thornton <ben.thornton@arkwell.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arkwell exec demo — VP availability and break-glass on-call sponsor

Looping in to confirm coverage. I can serve as the break-glass coordinator and will be on-call for the fallback window (Tue 11/2 10:00–10:45). Neha — can you confirm you’ll lead the demo flow for the product portion?

I’ll create the invites and a 15-minute pre-brief (11/2 09:15 PT) as discussed. For exec escalation I’ll use SMS + Microsoft Teams ping to reach the VP. Samira — please confirm the best contact method for your VP for fast reach (SMS number or Teams handle).

Action items I’ll take now:
- Create calendar invites (primary slot + fallback + pre-brief) and share links
- Publish one-paragraph sponsor runbook to the Drive link and attach to invite
- Upload MAP_Arkwell_v1.xlsx to the deal record in HubSpot (AW-2026-1031)

Neha — once you validate the agenda I’ll lock the invites.

Cheers,
Priyom
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
